title: fix: pass expand/select through full API chain for populate/lookup support
body:
populate/expand parameters were accepted at the HTTP layer but silently dropped before reaching the ObjectQL engine's `expandRelatedRecords`, so lookup/master_detail fields always returned raw IDs instead of expanded objects.

The engine implementation is correct — the gaps were in the layers above it:

- **RestServer** (`packages/rest`): `getData` handler ignored `expand`/`select` query params when calling `protocol.getData()`
- **MSW Plugin**: `ObjectStackServer.getData()` had no way to pass expand/select — added optional `options` param
- **Broker shims** (studio, client tests): Called `ql.find(object)` directly, bypassing the protocol's expand→populate normalization. Now delegate to the protocol service when available

### Chain before fix
```
GET /data/order_item/123?expand=order,product
  → broker.call('data.get', { object, id })        // expand lost here
    → ql.findOne(object, { filter: { _id: id } })  // no populate
      → { order: 'ord_1', product: 'prod_2' }      // raw IDs returned
```

### Chain after fix
```
GET /data/order_item/123?expand=order,product
  → protocol.getData({ object, id, expand })
    → engine.findOne(object, { populate: ['order','product'] })
      → expandRelatedRecords(...)
        → { order: { _id: 'ord_1', ... }, product: { _id: 'prod_2', ... } }
```

### Full-chain audit & test coverage

A comprehensive audit was performed across all API entry points to verify expand/populate parameter flow:

- **All adapters verified** (Express, Fastify, Hono) — correctly pass query params to dispatcher
- **HttpDispatcher `handleData`** — allowlists select/expand for GET by ID, passes full query for list
- **Protocol `findData`/`getData`** — normalizes expand/$expand/populate → engine
- **Engine `toQueryAST`** — populate → expand mapping → `expandRelatedRecords`

**Tests added (27 new tests across 3 layers):**
- **17 protocol-data tests** (`packages/objectql/src/protocol-data.test.ts`) — findData/getData expand/populate/$expand normalization, select normalization, pagination, response shape, error handling
- **6 HttpDispatcher handleData tests** (`packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.test.ts`) — expand/select allowlisting on GET by ID, full query pass-through for list, populate forwarding, body expand for POST query
- **4 REST server tests** (`packages/rest/src/rest.test.ts`) — getData and findData expand/select forwarding on both single-record and list endpoints

> *This section details on the original issue you should resolve*

> <issue_title>[长期] 彻底解决 populate/expand/lookup 字段关联查不到数据等后端根本性问题</issue_title>
> <issue_description>## 背景
> 在平台实际环境下，objectui 和 console 项目调用 spec 项目的数据 API 时，通过 populate/expand（或 lookup 字段）无法得到预期的对象展开关联数据。例如：
> GET /api/v1/data/order_item?populate=order,product 返回的 order/product 字段只是 ID，没有被扩展成对应对象。
> 
> 本问题不是 studio 或 mock 环境代码导致，而是 spec 仓库主线后端真实实现的系统性缺陷：
> - populate/lookup/expand 参数被正确地接收，但有多种场景未能深入解析并驱动底层数据引擎展开关联对象。
> - 除了主 objectql engine 的 expand 功能外，API 层、协议转换适配/ast、driver等链路可能有遗漏或绕行，导致大量真实接口无法获得关联数据。
> - 案例参考见 objectui 项目相关 PR 和 bug 讨论。
> 
> ## 长期解决目标
> - 任何接入 objectstack-ai/spec 的 API（无论 rest/odata/rpc），只要有 populate/expand/lookup 参数，返回内容都应与 schema 及字段定义严格一致：
>    - lookup/master_detail 字段自动转为对象，并展开 select 指定内容（递归/nested 支持3层+）
>    - 保证和 objectql find/findOne 直接用 expand 能力效果一致
> - 彻底补齐 API protocol → objectql → driver 全链路参数流转，杜绝任何场景下参数传递或处理被忽略
>    - 包括所有 http-dispatcher、broker、protocol implementation、engine toQueryAST 及 schema registry 驱动
> - 标准化所有 lookup/expand 返回（支持 depth，支持 select，嵌套安全、性能合理）
> - 完善自动化测试，验证所有 API 入口都能真正返回 fully expanded object
> - 完整补文档/注释，提升开发集成信心
> 
> ## 影响范围
> - /api/v1/data/ 对象的 rest/odata 等接口与协议所有查接口，特别是 lookup、populate、expand（包括 frontend 各种数据适配器）
> - objectql engine、protocol、http-dispatcher、broker、driver以及 schema 相关
> - 自动化单测/[insert test infra]
> 
> ## 参考资料
> - objectui PR objectstack-ai/spec#944 与相关试验与复现步骤
> - 用户实际 API 调用与截图
> - objectql/src/engine.ts expandRelatedRecords 实现，protocol 二层参数流转与转换
> 
> ## 路线建议（可增补）
> 1. 跟踪 populate/expand 全链路流向和覆盖，补齐适配遗漏
> 2. 对所有类型驱动（rest/odata）实现严格流程参数测试
> 3. 标准化和补齐嵌套 expand 案例（带多级 select/projection）
> 4. 完善主对象 expand 代码注释、示范和接口注释
> 5. 推动社区/前端同步规范，方便 console/objectui 等团队调用
